subject: Request: short extension + promotional credit for Riverbend archive curation pilot
messages:
From: Dr. Lian Zhou <lian.zhou@riverbendarchive.org>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Short extension request for our pilot credits

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the onboarding help last week — the team is now running nightly ingest + dedup and the initial quality checks look promising. We’ve hit a snag on the back end: our implementation window was shorter than expected and our current promo credits are set to expire at the end of March.

Would Redwood consider a short extension or a small supplemental credit so we can finish the curation sweep and produce the evaluation set we promised to our funders? We estimate ~50k additional tokens (~$2k equivalent) to finish the curation and anonymization stage. If needed I can share a one-page impact summary and the org’s grant letter.

Attached: RBCA-project-plan-v2.pdf (project plan), usage_snapshot-mar2027.csv (current token burn summary)

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if that’s easier.

Best,
Lian
Dr. Lian Zhou
Director, Riverbend Community Archive
procurement@riverbendarchive.org

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Lian Zhou <lian.zhou@riverbendarchive.org>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short extension request for our pilot credits

Hi Lian — thanks for the quick note and for sharing the plan. Appreciate the clear ask and the usage snapshot; can you confirm two quick items so I can route this internally?

- Expected completion window if we grant the extension (dates)
- Whether the additional usage will be exclusively for deid/curation (so we keep it scoped to the existing trial agreement)

I’ve looped Marissa (grants & promos) and Ben (edu programs) to review. If it helps, we can provision a temporary credit while we finalize approvals — I’ll wait for the clarifications above and touch base internally for sign-off.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: usage_snapshot-mar2027.csv (provided by RBCA)

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Short extension request for our pilot credits — quick approval ask

Team — forwarding RBCA’s ask. TL;DR: small nonprofit archive, close to delivering a curated eval set to funders, requesting ~50k tokens / ~$2k supplemental credit or 30-day extension so they can finish anonymization runs. Attached RBCA-project-plan-v2.pdf and usage snapshot.

Proposal: apply a one-time $2,000 promo credit to their account (deal RBCA-2027-03), valid for 60 days from application. Monitor weekly usage; include a short MOU requiring acknowledgement of acceptable use and confirmation that the work is research/nonprofit archival (no resale). We can stitch this to an EDU/nonprofit promo box.

Ben — any concerns on precedent here for the education/nonprofit program?
Marissa — if you’re okay, can you sign-off (and loop legal for the MOU)? I’ll draft the short approval email to Lian once we have sign-off.

Attachments: RBCA-project-plan-v2.pdf

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-17T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short extension request for our pilot credits — quick approval ask

Monica — thanks for the summary. I’m supportive of the $2k promo credit for RBCA given the community benefit and clear deliverables. Please proceed with the following guards:

- Add explicit 60-day validity period from the date applied
- Require a signed MOU (one page) stating scope & no resale clause; route legal for approval (I’ll loop Legal Ops)
- Track usage weekly and flag any unusual spikes to CS

Ben — no objection from my side, but can you confirm we can map this to our nonprofit promo SKU so finance tags properly (HS-12345)?

If all OK we should apply credit by end of week and send formal confirmation to RBCA.

Marissa Cole
Grants & Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Lian Zhou <lian.zhou@riverbendarchive.org>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-03-19T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: $2,000 promotional credit and 60-day extension for Riverbend archive pilot

Hi Lian — good news. We’ve approved a one-time $2,000 promotional credit on your account (deal RBCA-2027-03). Key details:

- Credit amount: $2,000 USD applied as account credit
- Validity: 60 days from date of application
- Scope: limited to de-identification/curation/evaluation runs for the Riverbend Community Archive project; resale or commercial redistribution is not permitted
- Monitoring: our CS team will review weekly usage reports; we’ll flag and pause if usage patterns look inconsistent with the stated scope

Next steps for you:
1) Please review and sign the short MOU here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rBCA-Support-Docs (file: RBCA-MOU-2027-draft.docx). We’ll route to Legal for final sign-off once you sign.
2) Confirm a date window for the final curation run (recommended completion by 2027-05-18).

Attachments: SOW-Draft.pdf (short statement of work), RBCA-project-plan-v2.pdf (original)

If you’d like a quick sync to walk through the MOU terms, I’m available tomorrow morning. Congrats on the progress — excited to see the curated dataset.

Best,
Monica Patel
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
m: +1 (415) 555-0147
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
